attempts.summary: Joined node1's two segments (eth1↔node2, eth2↔node3) into one L2 domain via a Linux bridge (br0, STP off, no IP) on node1, assigned node2/node3 eth1 into a shared 192.168.50.0/24 subnet, verified direct ping and correct MAC learning per port (transparent bridging, not routing). Config persisted via a systemd oneshot unit on node1 (SONiC/Debian) and /etc/network/interfaces on node2/node3 (Alpine). Completed the mandatory sequential restart protocol on all three nodes with boot_id-based proof of restart and post-restart recovery verification.
